verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page documents several in-editor AI chores — auto light/dark component swaps, generating a color palette from a dropped-in photo, auto-sorting/renaming layers, and replacing placeholder text with context-aware copy — which cover the 'copy suggestions' and some 'asset chore' parts of the story. However, there is no evidence of built-in image generation or background removal, and 'content-aware fills' isn't explicitly documented beyond the palette/text features. Missing for 10: image generation, background removal, explicit content-aware fill, and independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI features actually working.
